note: Phase 1 of Top 20 CWE expansion. Deterministic AST signatures for the Batch 3A visitor implementations (Phase 2). All predicates must be statically resolvable from the AST without execution.

CWE-614.name: Sensitive Cookie Without Secure Flag
CWE-614.bad_predicate: secure kwarg absent or statically False
CWE-614.safe_predicate: secure kwarg statically True (including resolution through a kwargs dict: set_cookie(name, value, **opts) with opts['secure'] == True)
CWE-614.remediation: Always set secure=True (and httponly=True) on session/auth cookies and serve all traffic over HTTPS.

CWE-916.name: Use of Weak Password Hash
CWE-916.bad_predicate: fast hash applied to a value bound to a password-context name (including salted variants; salt does not cure insufficient computational effort)
CWE-916.context_exemption: fast hashes on non-password-context values (checksums, integrity digests) are safe
CWE-916.remediation: Use bcrypt, argon2, or PBKDF2 with high iteration counts for passwords. Fast hashes are acceptable only for non-secret integrity checksums.

CWE-759.name: Use of One-Way Hash without a Salt
CWE-759.bad_predicate: password-context hash computed without any salt operand (binary + with salt, or salted KDF)
CWE-759.context_exemption: unsalted hashes on non-password-context values (integrity checksums) are safe
CWE-759.remediation: Always salt password hashes with a unique per-user salt (bcrypt.gensalt(), os.urandom(16)/secrets.token_bytes(16), or PBKDF2 with a random salt).

CWE-434.name: Unrestricted File Upload
CWE-434.bad_predicate: user-controlled filename reaches save()/copy destination without sanitization or extension-whitelist containment
CWE-434.remediation: Sanitize filenames with werkzeug secure_filename(), enforce an extension whitelist, rename with uuid4, and store uploads outside the web root.

CWE-352.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery
bad_patterns: state-changing route without csrf_protect or token validation
CWE-352.remediation: Enable framework CSRF protection globally and validate tokens in every state-changing handler.

CWE-287.name: Improper Authentication (Hardcoded Bypass)
bad_patterns: hardcoded credential equality in auth branch (password == 'literal')
CWE-287.remediation: Enforce a single authentication path with verified credentials. Never gate auth on debug flags, hardcoded comparisons, or client-controlled parameters.

CWE-862.name: Missing Authorization (Insecure Direct Object Reference)
CWE-862.bad_predicate: object fetched by user-supplied id without an owner/user filter or authorization check in the same scope
CWE-862.safe_predicate: owner=request.user filter present, or explicit ownership check (abort(403)) before access
CWE-862.remediation: Always scope object lookups to the authenticated principal (owner=request.user) and verify authorization before returning data.

CWE-312.name: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information
CWE-312.context_exemption: persisting non-sensitive fields is safe; persisting one-way hashes of secrets is safe
CWE-312.remediation: Encrypt secrets at rest (Fernet/KMS/vault) or store only salted hashes. Never persist plaintext credentials.

CWE-319.name: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information
CWE-319.bad_predicate: URL scheme statically resolves to http:// (literal constant or constant through simple variable propagation)
CWE-319.safe_predicate: https:// scheme, or scheme validated at runtime (raise on non-https)
CWE-319.remediation: Use HTTPS/TLS for all sensitive traffic and enforce scheme validation before transmitting credentials.

CWE-489.name: Active Debug Code in Production
safe_patterns: debug flag sourced from environment with safe default
CWE-489.remediation: Disable debug mode in production. Source the flag from environment configuration with a safe default (off).
